brief: The English-language channel on Ukrainian banking and payments is a relay layer rather than an origin layer: nearly every quantitative story traces back to NBU releases (bank.gov.ua/en), restated within hours by Interfax-Ukraine, ukranews, UNN and Mezha, and interpreted with more depth by bne IntelliNews, Euromaidan Press and Kyiv Post. Genuinely additive foreign coverage clusters in payments trade press (Finextra, The Paypers, Global Government Fintech) for scheme- and regulation-level developments, in VC/deal media (Tech.eu, Vestbee, InVenture) plus first-party investor and law-firm announcements (UMAEF, Baker McKenzie) for market entries and M&A, and in CashEssentials and the European Payments Council for wartime cash and infrastructure narratives. The main structural weaknesses are the absence of a confirmed global-wire channel, no recurring EN series for ATM/POS installed base, and paywalls on the highest-value analytical sources (bne premium, Interfax wire, GlobalData/Euromonitor). Recommended posture: treat this cell as a fast signal detector and cross-border/deal channel, and always resolve figures back to the NBU release before use.
